scope: Manufactured affine P2 fields and metadata only; no real admission, observations, roles, draws, physics or RGB-D rendering.

tests.command: env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_campaign_c38_static_export.py

controls: Exact reviewed field/public force digest, object, load and domain binding before selected private array read
P2 shape interpolation independently matches existing P2 implementation
Only acquired rows exported; future field arrays are never opened
Future private field changes and current private constraint changes leave public prefix identical
Exact rest geometry binding; unqualified force substitution rejected
Separate private provenance, no material/support/mask/full-state/time fields in public output
Provided acquired-only measurement error realizations, SPD declared noise covariance; no random draws
limitations: Ideal material correspondences are not RGB-D perception
Static acquisition ledger is not time or a dynamic forecast
Trusted application boundary, not operating-system isolation
No real static domain or dataset is admitted
